description: This is a shell script implementing a manual release version bump tool. It scans git commits since a specified reference, maps changes to project components via metadata.yaml files, interprets PR labels, computes new version numbers, and optionally updates metadata.yaml files. It supports labels for breaking changes and documentation changes, and follows a specific semantic versioning scheme.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information about how to use the release script.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to stderr and exits the script.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the PR number associated with a commit SHA, using GitHub API if available.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Fetches labels for a given PR number from GitHub.

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines the component directory that a changed file belongs to based on its path.

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Identifies if a file path likely points to documentation or related files.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next semantic version and generation based on current version, generation, and bump type.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates version and generation fields in a component's metadata.yaml file.
